selector.rationale: Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome best explains the combination of cutaneous venous malformations, lipolymphedema, and the patient's family history of similar conditions and intracranial hemorrhage, supported by the presence of a KRIT1 variant which is more commonly associated with cerebral cavernous malformations but in this context aligns with the broader vascular malformation spectrum seen in Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome

rejected.label: Lipolymphedema
rejected.why: Too narrow, does not account for the full spectrum of vascular malformations and other systemic findings

rejected.label: Cerebral cavernous malformation
rejected.why: While the KRIT1 variant supports this, the clinical presentation is more consistent with Klippel-Trenaunay syndrome

rejected.label: Cutaneovisceral angiomatosis with thrombocytopenia
rejected.why: Lack of thrombocytopenia in the vignette makes this diagnosis less likely

rejected.label: Venous malformation
rejected.why: While present, it is part of a larger syndrome
